meownvr
I could understand if I was getting reported most games by lots of players, my BS going down. But one game? WTF? [/quote]
well your score goes down for 2 reasons:
1. from the reports you get from players, regardless if you did anything bad or not, this however varies based on what you were reported for and when, for example if you get reported as the match has began for comm abuse, it wont affect you much

2. the system itself will flag your behavior, this includes both comm abuse and behavior score going down, it solely depends on your actions in the game, for example, if you write curse words in english language, for each word some comm score will get reduced from your total score, this however depends on how often you use curse words, for example if you use a curse word once it wont do much, almost nothing, but if you write curse words 10 times in 30 second or something, it will heavily reduce your comm score, same goes for any griefing behavior, if you top player when die, spam their death timer, etc, all your actions affects your comm and behavior score, and its all judged by the system not the players

2 May @ 3:37am
ykw
Can we finally get rid of Comm Score? I honestly believe its much healthier for the game if you just get rid of toxicity reporting as well. It just incentivices staying silent and sometimes people literally just report others bc they dont like them for some mundane reason of taking a creep or whatever. Even that still counts towards lowering your score, even though you maybe used 1 swear word. The system doesnt take in context and should just be removed.

Let people be toxic, they will always be toxic if they want to, be it via swears or just griefing, and id rather have someone swear at me, than grief the game.
